name: Softr
summary: No-code builder for portals and internal tools on top of Softr databases or external data.
description: Softr builds client portals, internal tools and business apps without code. It includes its own databases, workflows, forms, mobile apps and built-in AI agents, and syncs with external data sources. An AI app builder can generate an app from a prompt, and an MCP server lets AI agents build tools.

howToUse.title: Open Softr
howToUse.description: Open Softr and start for free. Describe a business app in a prompt so the AI app builder can generate it. Softr builds the interface from that prompt.

howToUse.title: Add data and flows
howToUse.description: The app includes databases, workflows and forms. Softr syncs external sources, and you shape roles and permissions without code.

howToUse.title: Ship the portal
howToUse.description: Publish client portals or internal tools, turn on the built-in agents, and send out mobile apps. An MCP server lets other agents build alongside you.
